summary: Derive identity from the API key
description: SEC-06 and SEC-26. user_id and team_id come from the key directory. A client X-User-Id header is ignored. New keys have at least 128 bits and can be rotated.
scope: Header bob does not override key alice
A rotated key replaces the old one and has at least 16 bytes
acceptanceCriteria: Key k-alice maps to user alice and team team-1 even when X-User-Id is bob. new_api_key returns at least 16 bytes of entropy. After rotate, the old key does not resolve and the new key returns alice. SEC-06 SEC-26.
constraints: Do not trust a client-supplied user id header.
Do not accept a key shorter than 128 bits from new_api_key.
Do not leave a rotated key active.
